description: A hobbyist makes model trains and planes using wood and paint. A model train requires 3 units of wood and 3 units of paint. A model plane requires 4 units of wood and 2 units of paint. The hobbyist has available 120 units of wood and 90 units of paint. If the profit per model train is $8 and the profit per model plane is $10, how many of each should be made to maximize his profit?

WoodPerTrain.definition: Amount of wood required to produce one model train

PaintPerTrain.definition: Amount of paint required to produce one model train

WoodPerPlane.definition: Amount of wood required to produce one model plane

PaintPerPlane.definition: Amount of paint required to produce one model plane

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from producing model trains and model planes"
